_comment: Expected index facts after importing fixtures/synthetic/graph (files under logseq/bak and non-.md files are skipped). Page keys are lower-cased names. Backlinks are listed as [path, first content line of the referencing block]; order is not significant. Hand-written from PLAN.md rules.

basic._comment: file-derived name stays resolvable as alias of the title:: page

link target: First block with a [[Link Target]] and a #tag
DOING fourth [[Link Target]] again and [[link target]] lowercase

_notes: The block 'date:: [[Jun 25th, 2022]]' in ns%2Fchild.md is a bullet whose head line is itself a property line; it has properties [date] and empty content, and its property value produces a backlink with via='property'.
The raw first block of basic.md has empty content, so its backlink entry for 'demo' shows an empty first content line.
Self references (other___deep.md linking [[Renamed Deep]] / [[other/deep]]) ARE stored in the index; the Backlinks view hides entries whose source path equals the current page's path.
